CustomField.description: Lead Status values (comma-separated) of the stages a lead passes on the way to this one, whose Lead fields the portal's Edit popup also shows here, before this stage's own (for example Qualified: Contacted). On the portal every one of these fields is optional.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Comma-separated Lead Status values whose Lead fields this stage also shows (optional on the portal), e.g. Contacted, Qualified.
CustomField.label: Previous Stages
